@syntax value Mod divisor
The remainder after dividing the value by the divisor, written between the two numbers. The result has the sign of the value.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print 7 Mod 3
Print -7 Mod 3
Print 10 Mod 5
```

```text
1
-1
0
```
